name: Michael Flarup

doc_currency: First-party doc 'What Everyone Should Know About The Process of Designing Apps' (Medium, 2017-08-18) is still live and was republished on Smashing Magazine (2016-11-07), Apply Pixels blog (2019-12-12), and Software Times (2021-11-16); it is still referenced as current process guidance, though no 2022+ citations were found.
